meta.description: Get in early. Become a Puntr Founding Member: the first 100 members get a permanent numbered badge and full access, free. 18+. Predict what's next. Prove your worth.
meta.ogTitle: Puntr: Predict what's next. Prove your worth.

lead: Get in early. Become a Founding Member. Be part of what's next.
body: The first 100 members get a permanent, numbered Founding badge and full access, free. No card needed. Puntr launches on {{launch}}.

perks.title: What Founding Members get
perks.f1: A permanent Founding badge, numbered #1 to #100
perks.f2: Full access to posting, your record and the weekly leaderboard
perks.f3: 30 free Pay-As-You-Go credits a month for 3 months once they launch

s1.title: Join free
s1.body: Create your account with your email. You must be 18 or older.

s2.title: Back your call
s2.body: Post picks on upcoming football matches before kick-off. Each pick is locked and cannot be edited or deleted.

s3.title: Build a public record
s3.body: Picks are graded automatically, so your record speaks for you.

fine: Puntr is a prediction community, not a bookmaker. Joining is free and Founding spots are limited to the first 100 members.

last.title: Be part of what's next
last.body: Once the 100 spots are taken, Founding badges are closed for good.

pass.title: Founding Annual Pass
pass.body: 12 months of Puntr Pro for a once-off R299 (standard Pro is R99 a month, R1,188 a year). Open to the first {{spots}} founding members who claim it before {{deadline}}. Your 12 months start on launch day and it does not renew automatically.
pass.note: Claiming reserves your place and the price. You pay nothing today: we'll email you when checkout opens before launch.
pass.claimed: You're in. You hold place {{position}} of {{spots}}. We'll email you when checkout opens.
pass.already: You've already claimed place {{position}}. We'll email you when checkout opens.
pass.error: We couldn't claim your place just now. Please try again.
